_project_json_schema._comment: Full schema for data/projects/<RepoName>.json — all fields are optional unless noted
_project_json_schema.repoName: string   — REQUIRED. Must match GitHub repo name exactly
_project_json_schema.icon: string   — emoji icon shown on the card and project page
_project_json_schema.shortDesc: string   — 1-line summary shown on the card
_project_json_schema.fullDesc: string   — multi-paragraph description. Use \n\n for paragraphs, • for bullets
_project_json_schema.techStack: string[] — tools/frameworks listed on the project page (more detailed than tags)
_project_json_schema.highlights: string[] — 3-5 key achievement bullets shown prominently on the project page

links.label: string — button label
links.type: live | preview | docs | external   (github added automatically)

reports.title: string   — display title of the report/paper
reports.file: string   — path relative to /data/projects/, e.g. NERVI/reports/paper.pdf
reports.desc: string   — one-line description shown under the title

_project_json_schema.subRepos: string[] — related GitHub repo names grouped under this project
_project_json_schema.liveUrl: string   — fallback if links[] not set
_project_json_schema.docsUrl: string   — fallback if links[] not set
_project_json_schema.featured: boolean  — bubble to top of the grid

_link_types.github: Dark — added automatically, do not add manually
